title: Huang out as Nvidia CEO, SEC probe reported
since_label: Fri 6 Nov close, the last price before the weekend reports
status: Reuters reports SEC enforcement staff are examining Nvidia's accounting, and Yahoo Finance says the stock fell 14% on Fri 20 Nov, its seventh straight loss, before bouncing nearly 4% after hours. Business Recorder and Malay Mail report chair Harvey Jones has ruled out Huang's return even though Trump called for it, and the WSJ says Heidrick & Struggles is running the CEO search; no permanent CEO has been named, and the probe's focus and the delayed 10-Q are still open.
why: Nvidia is the anchor of the AI trade and one of the heaviest weights in the Nasdaq, which alts follow.
next_label: House committees' closed-door interview with Huang
sources: Reuters, WSJ, Yahoo Finance, Business Recorder, Malay Mail, Quartz, Seeking Alpha, CNBC

title: Iran and US trade strikes in the Gulf
since_label: Thu 12 Nov 00:00 UTC, before Iran reported the Sirik strike
status: The Times of Israel and Al Jazeera report three tankers were damaged in or near Hormuz on Sat 21 Nov while Iran held talks with a Qatari delegation, and Iran International reports Deputy Foreign Minister Gharibabadi called the US blockade an act of war. VINnews, citing Euronews, reports more than 14 tankers gathered near Kharg Island, but Windward found no organized convoy heading for the blockade line as of 20 Nov; no convoy has sailed and no ceasefire has been confirmed.
why: CoinDesk cites the Gulf escalation, with the dollar and Fed hike odds, behind the crypto sell-off; oil feeds straight into rate expectations.
sources: Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, Iran International, Euronews, Windward, VINnews, Ynet, CoinDesk

title: MSCI drops Strategy from its indexes
since_label: Wed 11 Nov close, before MSCI's after-hours announcement
status: Share Talk and Bitcoin News Digest report bitcoin fell to about $55,100 early Sat 21 Nov, its lowest since September 2024, before recovering to about $60,000 by Sunday per Coinbase data, and Cryptoticker says Strategy's 850,849 BTC sit roughly 23% below their average cost. MSCI's deletion takes effect after the close on 30 Nov, and Strategy estimates index trackers hold about 13 million shares, 3.1% of its stock; whether other index providers follow is still open.
why: Strategy is the largest corporate BTC holder, and forced selling of its shares tests the main route equity money takes into bitcoin.
sources: MSCI, Strategy, Coinbase, Share Talk, Bitcoin News Digest, Cryptoticker, Decrypt, Yahoo Finance

title: Binance $6.3B hack, stolen ETH on the move
since_label: Thu 29 Oct 00:00 UTC, before the hack was reported
status: Bitcoin.com News, citing Elliptic, reports the hackers moved about 488,000 ETH, worth about $860M, from 17 to 20 Nov into wallets of about 12,000 ETH each, and swapped about 39,000 ETH into roughly 1,100 BTC, mostly through THORChain. Cryptonews, citing Arkham, says about 224,700 ETH remain in the tracked addresses, and CoinDesk cites Elliptic's estimate that about $2.85B has been frozen or seized; an Abu Dhabi hearing on 1 Dec will decide whether 18 firms must hand over the assets they have frozen.
why: Stolen ETH that no issuer can freeze is being moved and swapped, a supply overhang for ETH and alts while crypto sentiment sits at extreme fear.
next_label: Abu Dhabi court hearing on frozen assets
sources: Elliptic, Bitcoin.com News, Cryptonews, Arkham, CoinDesk, Decrypt, Binance, Reuters

title: Anthropic IPO, the largest AI listing
since_label: Tue 10 Nov, when the price range was set
status: Seeking Alpha and CNBC data show ANT closed Fri 20 Nov at $88.91, down 8.5% from its $97.17 debut close, after touching $83.05, just above the $83 IPO price, and Yahoo Finance reports Nasdaq's president said the stock is on course for a fast-track entry into the Nasdaq 100. Bitcoin News Digest says bitcoin's weekly slide picked up after the debut failed to lift shares; whether ANT holds its IPO price when trading resumes Monday and the timing of index entry are still open.
why: A raise this size absorbs cash that would otherwise chase other risk, and its first-day close reprices every AI name.
sources: Seeking Alpha, CNBC, Yahoo Finance, CNN, Bitcoin News Digest, Investing.com
